summary: @ornikar/intl-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself identifier-obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and per-function string-property dictionaries) and downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/..., extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB single-line file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, large opaque lookup table `n7gIxM`, hex-mangled identifiers) and its contents are opaque. The package's declared purpose is a formatjs/intl configuration helper for the @ornikar org; there is no legitimate need for an intl-config helper to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and use it to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle. The alternate-runtime path also bypasses Node-oriented supply-chain tooling and hooks that inspect only `node` execution. This is the install-time-rce shape: whatever `math_init.js` does runs on every installer's machine as a side effect of `npm install`, with the author's chosen runtime and no installer visibility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
